entries.summary: New switch, Show pause button, under Settings > Menus. It adds a widget button that pauses your fake location and resumes it at the same place. It is off by default and does not show on the floating map.
The app no longer keeps your phone awake while nothing moves. It holds the wake lock only while you walk, roam or replay a route, and lets go when you pause.
The map now uses a version of the map engine that works on more phones.
